SELECT CAR_NO FROM ( SELECT CAR_NO FROM ( SELECT CAR_NO, SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) AS LAST_DIGIT,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) AS RN
FROM TM_NUMPLATE_LIST
WHERE USE_YN = 'N' AND PROC_ST IN ('M_END', 'S_REQ', 'S_ING', 'S_END')
AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 3, 1) NOT IN ('하', '허', '호') AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 4, 1) NOT IN ('하', '허', '호')
AND GOVT_ID = #{GOVT_ID} AND NUM_KIND = #{NUM_KIND} AND HOLE_YN = #{HOLE_YN} AND SEAL_YN = #{SEAL_YN}
AND SPECIAL_YN = 'Y'
AND CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{WANT_CAR_NO} || '%' AND ASSIGN_CD = #{ASSIGN_CD} AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 1, 2) >= DECODE( #{CAR_KD}, '70', '01', '80', '70', '97', '80' )
AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 1, 2) < DECODE( #{CAR_KD}, '97', '98', #{CAR_KD} )
AND ( #{CONDITION} = 'NOT' OR ( LENGTH(#{CONDITION}) = 2 AND REGEXP_LIKE( #{CONDITION}, '^[0-9]{2}$' ) AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) = SUBSTR(#{CONDITION}, 2, 1) ) )
AND CAR_NO NOT IN
#{carNo}
)
WHERE RN <= CASE LAST_DIGIT WHEN '0' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_0}, 0) WHEN '1' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_1}, 0) WHEN '2' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_2}, 0) WHEN '3' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_3}, 0) WHEN '4' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_4}, 0) WHEN '5' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_5}, 0) WHEN '6' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_6}, 0) WHEN '7' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_7}, 0) WHEN '8' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_8}, 0) WHEN '9' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_9}, 0) ELSE 0 END
ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE )
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{LIMIT}

mapper.select: SELECT D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN, D.CONFIRM_NO, N.REQ_CAR_NO, TO_CHAR(MAX(P.APPEAR_DT) + (5 / 1440), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXPIRES_AT, CASE WHEN MAX(P.APPEAR_DT) > SYSDATE - (5 / 1440) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ACTIVE_YN FROM TR_CARNO_DETACH D JOIN TR_NEWCAR N ON N.SERVICE_ID = D.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TM_NUMPLATE_LIST P ON P.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN = D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN WHERE D.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} GROUP BY D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN, D.CONFIRM_NO, N.REQ_CAR_NO
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TR_NEWCAR N USING ( SELECT D.SERVICE_ID, D.CONFIRM_NO FROM TR_CARNO_DETACH D WHERE D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN IS NOT NULL AND D.CONFIRM_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_NUMPLATE_LIST P WHERE P.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN = D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN AND P.USE_YN = 'P' AND P.APPEAR_DT <= SYSDATE - (5 / 1440) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_NUMPLATE_LIST P WHERE P.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN = D.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN AND P.APPEAR_DT > SYSDATE - (5 / 1440) ) ) E ON (N.SERVICE_ID = E.SERVICE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MEMO_TX = NVL(N.MEMO_TX || CHR(10), '') || '[' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '] ' || E.CONFIRM_NO || ' 미사용처리 완료'

UNION ALL SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID AS SERVICE_ID, '신규등록배송' AS CAR_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO AS POST_CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, (SELECT COMPANY_NM FROM TM_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_ID = TS.COMPANY_ID) AS BUY_NM, '' AS PROC_ST, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPIRE_DT, CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE1, CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE2, CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE3, CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE4, CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE6 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE6, TNI.IMAGE1_PATH AS IMAGE1_PATH, TNI.IMAGE2_PATH AS IMAGE2_PATH, TNI.IMAGE3_PATH AS IMAGE3_PATH, TNI.IMAGE4_PATH AS IMAGE4_PATH, TNI.IMAGE6_PATH AS IMAGE6_PATH, TNI.IMAGE_PATH_YN AS IMAGE_PATH_YN, TN.CARD_YN AS CARD_YN, TN.CARD_PAY_YN AS CARD_PAY_YN, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'YY/MM/DD') AS INSTALL_DT, '' AS INSTALL_TM, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'DLVGB' AND CODE_ID = TC.DELIVERY_GB) AS LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR, TC.TASK_CD AS NUM_GB, '' AS TASK_CD, '' as ETC5 FROM TM_NUM_MANAGER NM, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TC, TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NUMPLATE_IMAGES TNI, TM_CODE CD WHERE SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO),'-',''),-8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO},'-',''),-8) AND NM.MANAGER_NM = TC.INSTALL_NM AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TC.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TNI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND CD.GROUP_ID = 'TPRST' AND TS.PROC_ST = CD.CODE_ID AND TC.FILENAME1 IS NULL AND (TC.ETC2 != 'Y' OR TC.ETC2 IS NULL) AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= SYSDATE - 60 AND (TC.INSTALL_YN IS NULL OR TC.INSTALL_YN != 'Y') AND SUBSTR(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('T_CAN', 'DEL')
AND ( TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) OR TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) OR TRUNC(SYSDATE) = ( SELECT MAX(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET) FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS DAY_OFFSET FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 31 ) D WHERE (TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET - TRUNC(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET, 'IW')) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND INSTR( ',' || NVL(( SELECT REPLACE(H.DETAIL_NM, ' ', '') FROM TM_CODE H WHERE H.GROUP_ID = 'ETC..' AND H.CODE_ID = 'HOLID' AND ROWNUM = 1 ), '') || ',', ',' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET, 'YYYYMMDD') || ',' ) = 0 ) )
AND ((TC.INSTALL_DT IS NOT NULL AND TC.INSTALL_TM IS NOT NULL) OR (TS.COMPANY_ID = 'CB407' AND TS.PROC_ST = 'N_DLV'))
AND TN.OWNER_NM LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%'
AND (TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%' or TC.POST_CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%')
ORDER BY INSTALL_DT NULLS FIRST, INSTALL_TM NULLS FIRST
, INSTALL_DT ASC, INSTALL_TM ASC

TC.POST_CAR_NO, NVL(TN.CAR_NM, NVL(TM.CAR_NM, NC.CAR_NM)) AS CAR_NAME, NVL(TN.COLOR_GB, TM.COLOR_GB) AS COLOR_GB, NVL(TN.MADE_YY, NVL(TM.MADE_YY, NC.MADE_YY)) AS MADE_YY, NVL(TB.BUY_NM, NVL(TM.BUY_NM, NC.OWNER_NM)) AS BUY_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.RECEIVE_TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR) AS LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR, TO_CHAR(TC.INSTALL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSTALL_DT, SUBSTR(TC.INSTALL_TM, 1, 2) AS INSTALL_TIME, SUBSTR(TC.INSTALL_TM, 3, 1) || '0' AS INSTALL_MINUTES, TC.MEMO_TX, TC.NUM_MEMO_TX, TC.INSTALL_NM, TC.TOKEN, TC.TASK_CD AS NUM_KIND, NVL(TN.TASK_CD, '') AS TASK_CD, NVL(TN.CAR_KD, NVL(TM.CAR_KD, NC.CAR_KD)) AS CAR_KD, NVL(TC.SONGJANG_NO, '없음') AS SONGJANG_NO, CASE WHEN TN.SERVICE_ID IS NULL THEN '비수도권' ELSE DECODE(TN.ETC5, 'Y', '비수도권', NVL((SELECT MAX(NM.GUBUN) FROM TM_NUM_MANAGER NM WHERE NM.MANAGER_NM = TC.INSTALL_NM AND SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO}, '-', ''), -8)), '비수도권')) END AS SUDO, TC.HOLE_YN, TC.SEAL_YN, TC.INSTALL_YN, NVL(TN.BOND_YN, NVL(TM.BOND_YN, NC.BOND_YN)) AS BOND_YN, NVL((SELECT MAX(CD.CODE_NM) FROM TM_CODE CD WHERE CD.GROUP_ID = 'NSUBP' AND CD.CODE_ID = NVL(TN.BOND_YN, NVL(TM.BOND_YN, NC.BOND_YN))), '선택안함') AS BOND_NM, NVL(TN.RUN_KM, 0) AS RUN_KM, DECODE(NVL(TN.ETC5, DECODE(TM.MDF_GB, 'BNUM', 'Y', '')), 'Y', 'Y', '') AS ETC5, NVL(TN.CARD_YN, '') AS CARD_YN, NVL(TN.CARD_PAY_YN, '') AS CARD_PAY_YN, NVL(TN.MEMO_TX, TM.MEMO_TX) AS TN_MEMO_TX, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TB.CARP_ADDRESS) || ' ' || PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TB.CARP_ADDRESS_DT) AS CARP_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(TC.INSU_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSU_START_DT , CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE1 , CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE2 , CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE3 , CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE4 , CASE WHEN TNI.IMAGE6 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IMAGE6 , TNI.IMAGE1_PATH, TNI.IMAGE2_PATH, TNI.IMAGE3_PATH, TNI.IMAGE4_PATH, TNI.IMAGE6_PATH FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_CARNO_DETACH TC ON TC.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_TRNSNAME TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_TRNSNAME_BUY TB ON TB.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_MODIFY TM ON TM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_NEWCAR NC ON NC.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_NUMPLATE_IMAGES TNI ON TNI.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_NUM_MANAGER NM WHERE NM.MANAGER_NM = TC.INSTALL_NM AND SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO}, '-', ''), -8) AND SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO}, '-', ''), -8) )

SELECT TT.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TT.RT_ACC_NM AS OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TT.RT_ACC_NO) AS VBANK_NO, TT.RT_BANK_CD AS VBANK_NM, TT.BOND_YN, TT.TOTAL_AMT, TT.RT_AMT, TP.PAY_AMT AS TNUM_PAY_AMT, (SELECT PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(P.VBANK_NO) FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'ACQ') AS ACQ_VBANK_NO, (SELECT PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(P.VBANK_NO) FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'BOND') AS BOND_VBANK_NO, NVL((SELECT P.PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'BOND'), 0) AS BOND_AMT, TT.PAY_GB FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_TRNSNAME TT ON TT.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID JOIN TR_PAYMENT TP ON TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND TP.PAY_KD = 'TNUM' WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} UNION ALL SELECT TM.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TM.RT_ACC_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TM.RT_ACC_NO), TM.RT_ACC_CD, TM.BOND_YN, TM.TOTAL_AMT, TM.RT_AMT, TP.PAY_AMT, (SELECT PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(P.VBANK_NO) FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'ACQ'), (SELECT PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(P.VBANK_NO) FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'BOND'), NVL((SELECT P.PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND P.PAY_KD = 'BOND'), 0), TM.PAY_GB FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_MODIFY TM ON TM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID JOIN TR_PAYMENT TP ON TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND TP.PAY_KD = 'TNUM' WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
